title: Fourier asymptotics of critical Gaussian multiplicative chaos on the circle
summary: We study the high-frequency Fourier coefficients $C_n$ of critical Gaussian multiplicative chaos $M$ on the circle, for logarithmic covariances with an arbitrary admissible smooth, possibly nonstationary remainder. For every fixed finite set of integer offsets, the corresponding vector of neighboring coefficients, multiplied by $\sqrt{\log n}$, converges stably relative to the full Gaussian field without additional centering. Conditionally on that field, the limit consists of Fourier coefficients of one symmetric complex stable random measure of index one with control proportional to $M$.…
